description: Execute one signed Power Screen quote and return an immediate modeled constraint decision, assumptions, evidence gaps, and immutable artifact hash. Inputs: quoteToken (required). Cost: $1.00 per call from prepaid balance (new keys include 3 trial calls on tools up to $0.25). Example: {"quoteToken":"<quoteToken from get_power_service_quote>"} [$1.00/call]

apiKey.description: Optional one-call credential bridge for MCP hosts that cannot change Authorization headers mid-session. EnergyAI strips it before billing, execution, and persistence.

quoteToken.description: Unmodified signed quoteToken returned by get_power_service_quote. The quote expires after 15 minutes and binds scope, price, and assumptions.

name: run_power_screen
